## What's new in Igggy 0.1.14
- **Your recent notes are in the sidebar.** The eight newest notes sit under Notes, with a recording or a note being written at the top. All notes opens the full list, and the section can be collapsed. - **One place to add anything.** New (⌘N), at the bottom of the sidebar, opens a window for pasting a transcript or notes, adding a link, adding an audio recording or transcript file, or importing notes from another app or folder. You can also drop a file onto the window. - **Write notes from audio and transcript files.** Add an .m4a, .mp3, .wav, .aiff or .caf recording, or a .txt, .vtt or .srt transcript, and Igggy writes the note. Audio is transcribed on your Mac. - **Watch a note being written.** After you add something, its note opens right away and fills in when it's done. If something goes wrong, Try again works without adding it a second time. - **A simpler sidebar.** The Tasks & Decisions and People pages are gone. Tasks and decisions stay on each note, and Igggy keeps tracking people and topics for search and the meeting brief. - **Switching between notes is steadier.** A note opens complete, without the page shifting as it loads. - **Note details travel with your library.** Which engine wrote a note, where its copy was saved, its calendar link and the tasks you've checked off are now kept inside your Igggy Library, so they survive moving the library or setting up a new Mac.
